headline: Bitcoin drifts to about $75,700 in thin weekend trading with sentiment at Extreme Fear, as Binance's finance chief steps down while the exchange recovers from its record hack.

market.asOf: The desk could not read CoinGecko on this run; last prices seen in news reports late Sat 7 Nov, up to about 22:13 UTC (05:13 Sun Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 25 (Extreme Fear) on Saturday 7 Nov, after 28 on Friday and 50 on Thursday, per CryptoTicker.

stories.title: Binance's finance chief steps down as the exchange recovers from its record hack
stories.summary: Binance says CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving and Justin Yek takes over, adding that the change was planned for months and is not linked to the hack. Blockchain analysts say the hackers keep swapping stolen tokens into bitcoin.
points: Co-CEO Yi He said Ng "has decided to pursue a new venture after more than five years"; Binance calls it a transition planned over the last six months, per Head Topics.
Elliptic puts the theft at $6.43B, with $2.85B frozen and $3.11B still in linked wallets, per Coin-Turk.
Reports of how much stolen crypto has been swapped into bitcoin differ: about 1,650 BTC from $124M of tokens per Coin-Turk, and about 2,300 BTC from $175M in a later Gokhshtein report.
Binance says it has replenished 98% of the affected token assets and customers will bear no losses, per crypto.news.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips to about $75,700 as sentiment stays at Extreme Fear
stories.summary: Bitcoin edged lower through a quiet Saturday after a week of heavy selling from US bitcoin funds. The main sentiment gauge sits at Extreme Fear, and Tuesday's US inflation report is the next big data point.
points: Bitcoin was about $75,720 late Saturday, flat on the day and down 2.3% on the week, per 24/7 Wall St.
That is 39.9% below its $126,080 all-time high, per 24/7 Wall St.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had $411.9M of net outflows on 6 Nov and about $1.28B over the 2-6 Nov week, per crypto.news.
The alternative.me Fear & Greed Index read 25 (Extreme Fear), down from 50 on Thursday, per CryptoTicker.
Friday's low was $74,722 on Coinbase data, per CryptoTicker; crypto.news puts the week's low at $74,888.

sources.label: 24/7 Wall St: bitcoin and Mercado Bitcoin

stories.title: MEXC faces a US cut-off as its USDT withdrawals stay disrupted
stories.summary: The US Treasury's financial-crimes unit, FinCEN, ordered US banks and payment firms to stop handling transfers involving crypto exchange MEXC. MEXC says no assets are frozen, but several USDT withdrawal networks were down on Saturday and money has been leaving the exchange.
points: The order takes effect 30 days after it is published in the Federal Register; that date was not yet set on Saturday, per 24/7 Wall St.
FinCEN alleges MEXC handled $16.7B of illicit transactions from May 2021 to May 2026, per CryptoSlate via cryptonews.net; 24/7 Wall St says at least $16B.
Only 6 of 18 USDT withdrawal networks were available on 7 Nov, with Ethereum up and TRON, Solana, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and Polygon down, per FinanceFeeds.
MEXC saw about $126M of net outflows over 24 hours, per DefiLlama data cited by cryptonews.net.

briefs.title: Keplr pauses social login after a wallet flaw
briefs.summary: Keplr paused Google and Apple sign-in after a flaw at Web3Auth exposed private keys; outflows were reported on INJ, OSMO and ATOM, no loss total is confirmed, and seed-phrase and hardware-wallet accounts are not affected, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Mercado Bitcoin partly reopens on 9 Nov
briefs.summary: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin reopens in view-only mode on 9 Nov after a cyberattack froze withdrawals on 2 Nov; withdrawals and trading stay locked with no timeline, per 24/7 Wall St.

briefs.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details
briefs.summary: Exposed data includes card numbers, home addresses and linked wallets; funds were not affected and the legacy card system shuts down on 20 Dec, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Travel-rule tightening withdrawn
briefs.summary: A Treasury and Fed proposal to cut the travel-rule threshold from $3,000 to $250 was withdrawn, effective 9 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: SEC and CFTC crypto proposals at the White House
briefs.summary: The White House budget office is reviewing an SEC proposal on broker-dealer rules for crypto and a CFTC proposal on prediction-market consumer protections, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Samsung Wallet adds USDC purchases
briefs.summary: Eligible US Samsung Wallet users can buy USDC with Samsung Pay, cards or bank transfer, processed by Stripe; New York is excluded and balances have no FDIC or SIPC cover, per cryptonews.net.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule still at the White House
briefs.summary: The Labor Department rule on crypto in 401(k) plans went to White House review on 5 Nov and is still pending, per crypto.news.
